hook.lifetime: install after Bridge.load, before bridge.run; defer stop spans full bridge.run; stop calls UnhookWindowsHookEx
hook.failure: guard install failure prints SWR_STARTUP_ERROR and exits 78 before bridge.run
hook.default: flag absent leaves hook disabled; renderer/runtime/ABI unchanged

driverJoin.input: WM_CHAR PostMessage to retained workload HWND only
driverJoin.metrics: WindowMetrics/client metrics, QPC input, activity, resource, renderer timing streams retained

qualification.startup: guard-installed marker before first renderer-ready/window event
qualification.background: background_noactivate=PASS, HWND_BOTTOM, SWP_NOACTIVATE, positive client metrics
qualification.admission: guard marker + worker source pins + no foreground takeover + all workload receipt joins
